info.title: Find@ Public API
info.description: Public API for the Find@ platform. This specification covers non-admin endpoints and API key based access only. OAuth, plans, and admin user management endpoints are intentionally excluded.

error.description: Error flag (0 or 1). In some responses it is returned as string.

status.description: Account plan status, e.g. free, pro

domain.description: Branded domain including http or https.

type.description: Redirection type [direct, frame, splash] or id/overlay-id for advanced modes.

data.description: Data to be embedded. Type varies by QR type.

post.summary: Assign a link to a campaign
Assign an item to a channel

parameters.name: short
parameters.description: Search using short URL. If present, other filters are ignored.

200.description: List of links or single link if `short` is used and matches
